subtitles.awaken.ascent.rope_fire: A line of light is thrown
subtitles.awaken.ascent.vow_line: A line of light is given
awaken.ascent.remember.title: Your body remembers.
awaken.ascent.vow.call: The vault has recognised the chain.
awaken.ascent.vow.how: Hold %s to throw it. Let go to fly.
awaken.ascent.vow.mast: Throw it at the mast and climb up there.
awaken.ascent.vow.kept: That's it. The rope is yours.
awaken.ascent.vow.lapsed: The mast will still be here when you come back.
awaken.ascent.vow.stir: The vault notices you, then goes quiet.
awaken.ascent.vow.waits: It is waiting for a %s-rank hunter.
awaken.ascent.vow.stir_door: The vault notices you. Its door will open for you.
awaken.ascent.mastery.tether.gain: the line reaches further, the swing pumps harder
awaken.ascent.mastery.wings.gain: the wings slip through the air
awaken.ascent.gift.wings.how: In a fall, press jump to open them.
awaken.ascent.core.built: The core stays dark. It won't answer anyone who built their way up here. Climb its rings with your rope.
awaken.ascent.core.rank: The core stays dark. It's waiting for a %1$s-rank hunter, so come back when you've reached rank %1$s.
awaken.ascent.gift.leap: That was the leap. It's yours.
awaken.ascent.gift.leap.how: In the air: jump again, sprint to dash, sneak to slam from high up.
awaken.ascent.edge.leap: You can jump again in the air now.
awaken.ascent.edge.leap.how: Jump, then press jump again in the air.
awaken.ascent.trial.leaper.open: A gate has opened in front of you. It is a course, not a fight.
awaken.ascent.trial.skyborn.open: A gate opens onto open sky: the Sky Leviathan's trial.
awaken.ascent.gift.sky: You can fly now. It's yours.
awaken.ascent.gift.sky.how: On open wings, jump again to fly. Forward pushes on, sprint boosts.
awaken.ascent.edge.sky.how: Open your wings, then jump again to fly.
awaken.ascent.gift.sovereign: You can take the Sovereign's form now.
awaken.ascent.gift.sovereign.how: When the gold line is full, press %s. It lasts thirty seconds.
awaken.ascent.sovereign.aether: Not yet: the Aether must be full.
awaken.ascent.spire.built: The crown stays dark. It only answers someone who climbed by rope.
awaken.ascent.core.line: The core stays dark. It only answers someone who climbed its rings with the rope, not with a pearl, a flight or bare hands.
